meta.content: Independent mobile app and game publishing studio. Discover our apps on Google Play.
meta.name: description

div.h1: We build apps people love to use.
div.p: Super Intel is an independent mobile publishing studio crafting fast, beautiful and privacy-friendly apps and games for Android users worldwide.
Every product we publish is designed with care, tested on real devices and supported with regular updates.

article.p: A minimal Pomodoro timer that helps you stay focused, track sessions and build better work habits.
Fast, beautiful notes with folders, reminders and offline support. Your ideas, organised everywhere.
A relaxing yet addictive block puzzle game with hundreds of levels, daily challenges and leaderboards.

div.p: We handle the full lifecycle of every app we publish.
Native-quality Android apps built with modern tools and clean, maintainable code.
Clean, intuitive interfaces that follow Material Design and feel great to use.
We collect only what is needed and follow Google Play policies and data-safety rules.
Regular improvements, bug fixes and new features based on user feedback.

div.h2: A small studio with big standards
div.p: Founded with a simple mission: create useful, delightful mobile experiences that respect people's time and privacy. We are a passionate team of developers and designers publishing on Google Play.

ul.li: Transparent privacy policies for every app
No intrusive ads, no hidden tracking

div.p: Have a question about one of our apps, a business enquiry or feedback? We usually reply within 24–48 hours.
